content.text: Stripe webhooks sometimes arrive before the invoice row is committed, and we drop them. Acme Corp lost two payments this way. Add retries so no payment is lost.

The handler looks up the invoice right away and returns 200 even when it isn't there yet, so Stripe never retries. I'm storing every event in a webhook_events table first, then processing it with retries at 1s, 4s and 16s.
Done. In the replay test with 500 out-of-order events, dropped webhooks went from 7 to 0. Files: src/webhooks/stripe.ts, src/webhooks/queue.ts, migrations/0008_webhook_events.sql.
